name: A second bearing

date.label: The Burning Crusade · quest sequence; exact date unknown

summary: The first reading returns to Hazzin, who recalibrates the device. A second point lies far to the west, and the seeker carries the new reading to Wind Trader Tuluman near Manaforge Ara. The two points do not yet name a single object or settle its origin; they narrow the search. Tuluman’s report gives the prince a general vicinity for the crystal, enough to replace legend with a destination but not yet with possession.
